# EuroRWA

EuroRWA tracks tokenized money-market funds (RWA) and produces a daily analyst
report that is hashed, signed and attested on-chain.

## API

- Paid (x402, $0.05 USDC on Base): `POST /api/analyst` — latest analyst report with BUY/HOLD/SELL signals
- Open: `GET /api/overview`, `/api/funds`, `/api/yields`, `/api/flows`, `/api/analytics`, `/api/alerts`
- MCP server (Streamable HTTP): `POST /mcp` — tools `overview`, `funds`, `analytics`, `alerts`; resources `eurorwa://analyst/latest`, `eurorwa://funds/latest`
- Discovery: `/.well-known/x402.json`, `/.well-known/agent-services.json`, `/.well-known/mcp.json`, `/.well-known/openapi.json`, `/.well-known/ai-plugin.json`

## Sample response (GET /api/overview)

```json
{
  "date": "2026-08-06",
  "signals": [{ "ticker": "USYC", "action": "HOLD", "confidence": "medium", "reasons": ["..."] }],
  "verified": true,
  "attestation": { "key": "2026-08-06-analyst-2", "tx": "0x...", "block": 11430480 }
}
```
